CBSA.CICSBSA.ABNDFILE.recovery_why: etc/install/base/installjcl/BANK.csd: DEFINE FILE(ABNDFILE) ... RECOVERY(NONE) -- the abend log a backout must not undo

scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0 at a terminal with upper-case translation on (UCTRAN): STORE-TERM-DEF INQUIREs UCTRANST, keeps it and SETs NOUCTRAN; the map sent ERASE; RETURN TRANSID('ODCS') LENGTH(266) with the stored CVDA in WS-COMM-TERM

scenarios.name: first-entry-nouctran
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0 at a terminal already NOUCTRAN: nothing SET

scenarios.name: pa1
scenarios.why: PA1: CONTINUE, nothing sent; the DFHCOMMAREA copied to WS-COMM-AREA, RETURN TRANSID

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: PF3: RESTORE-TERM-DEF SETs the terminal's UCTRANST back to the COMMAREA's (451, NOUCTRAN), RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: PF12: RESTORE-TERM-DEF, the termination message, RETURN

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: RESTORE-TERM-DEF, SEND CONTROL ERASE FREEKB, RETURN

scenarios.name: other-key
scenarios.why: PF7: WHEN OTHER -- 'Invalid key pressed.', SEND MAP DATAONLY ALARM

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: ENTER with no field modified: RECEIVE MAP ... TERMINAL ASIS is MAPFAIL -- RM010 LINKs ABNDPROC (an ABNDFILE record), RESTORE-TERM-DEF, ABEND HBNK

scenarios.name: inquire
scenarios.why: ENTER with customer 1: RECEIVE MAP ... TERMINAL ASIS (lower case kept, X28), BIF DEEDIT, LINK INQCUST (run in the task: READ FILE('CUSTOMER') by the program's own sort code) -- the customer shown, name, address split into three lines, dates and credit score

scenarios.name: inquire-professor
scenarios.why: ENTER with customer 4, a longer name and title

scenarios.name: inquire-not-found
scenarios.why: ENTER with customer 5, not on the CUSTOMER file: INQCUST 'N' -- the not-found message

scenarios.name: inquire-no-number
scenarios.why: ENTER with only the sort code typed (CUSTNOL 0): 'Please enter a customer number.', no LINK

scenarios.name: inquire-deedited
scenarios.why: ENTER with '00-0000001': BIF DEEDIT leaves 0000000001

scenarios.name: amend
scenarios.why: PF10 on customer 2's screen (every shown field comes back with the RECEIVE): EDIT-DATA and VALIDATE-DATA pass, UNPROT-CUST-DATA keeps the shown customer in the COMMAREA (COMM-UPD 'Y'), the name and address fields unprotected, green and underlined -- 'Amend data then press <ENTER>.'

scenarios.name: amend-sortcode-zero
scenarios.why: PF10 with sort code 000000: 'The Sort code / Customer number combination is not VALID.'

scenarios.name: amend-last-customer
scenarios.why: PF10 with customer 9999999999: 'The customer number is not VALID.'

scenarios.name: delete-customer-zero
scenarios.why: PF5 with customer 0000000000: VALIDATE-DATA refuses it, no LINK DELCUS

scenarios.name: delete-three-accounts
scenarios.why: PF5 with customer 1 (three accounts): VALIDATE-DATA passes, DEL-CUST-DATA LINKs DELCUS (INQCUST, INQACCCU, a DELACC per account, the CUSTOMER record deleted) -- the 'successfully deleted' message, the map's fields blanked

scenarios.name: delete-one-loan
scenarios.why: PF5 with customer 2, one LOAN account with a negative balance: one DELACC, then the customer is deleted

scenarios.name: delete-null-statement-date
scenarios.why: PF5 with customer 3, whose account has a NULL last-statement date: INQACCCU's FETCH fails (-305), no account is returned, DELCUS deletes the customer alone

scenarios.name: delete-not-on-file
scenarios.why: PF5 with customer 5, which has an account but no CUSTOMER record: DELCUS fails with code 1 -- 'that Cust no was not found. Customer NOT deleted.', nothing deleted

scenarios.name: delete-ioerr
scenarios.why: PF5 with customer 2 when the DELETE of the CUSTOMER record fails with IOERR: DELCUS fails with code 3 -- 'a delete error occurred. Customer NOT deleted.'

scenarios.name: update
scenarios.why: ENTER with COMM-UPD 'Y': EDIT-DATA2 accepts the title 'Mrs' and the address, UPDATE-CUST-DATA LINKs UPDCUST (run in the task: the CUSTOMER record rewritten with the new name and address) -- the success message

scenarios.name: update-title-dr
scenarios.why: an update with the title 'Dr'

scenarios.name: update-bad-title
scenarios.why: an update titled 'Captain': 'Valid titles are: Mr,Mrs,Miss,Ms,Dr,Professor,...', no LINK

scenarios.name: update-blank-address
scenarios.why: an update with all three address lines blank: 'Address must not be all spaces', no LINK

scenarios.name: update-not-found
scenarios.why: an update of customer 5, not on file: UPDCUST 'N' -- its failure message

notes: CBSA's display / amend / delete-customer screen (BNK1DCS, transaction ODCS, BMS map BNK1DC of mapset BNK1DCM: the symbolic map is generated from src/base/bms_src/BNK1DCM.bms, @bms/BNK1DCM.cpy). Its terminal is a stated fact of the run: T001 (EIBTRMID), UCTRANST NOUCTRAN unless a scenario says UCTRAN (INQUIRE / SET TERMINAL UCTRANST, oracle_assumptions.md X26); a first task stores the terminal's UCTRANST in the COMMAREA and turns translation off, and every exit (PF3 / PF12 / CLEAR, an abend) SETs it back from the COMMAREA (WS-COMM-TERM 451 in every returning scenario). ENTER inquires (LINK INQCUST); PF10 checks the customer and unprotects the name and address for amending (COMM-UPD 'Y'); ENTER with COMM-UPD 'Y' validates the title and address and LINKs UPDCUST; PF5 deletes through DELCUS. INQCUST, UPDCUST and ABNDPROC run in the task, as in cbsa-inqcust / cbsa-updcust. The COMMAREA compared is the one the program RETURNs, WS-COMM-AREA (LENGTH 266). CUSTOMER and ABNDFILE are compared after every scenario. PF5 deletes through DELCUS, LINKed in the task with INQCUST, INQACCCU and DELACC as in cbsa-delcus; its Db2 (ACCOUNT, PROCTRAN) is cbsa-delcus's seed.sql (SYNTHETIC) and is compared after every scenario. Not reached: a terminal whose translation is on when a RECEIVE follows the SET (IBM does not say when a SET UCTRANST takes effect: refused by both runtimes, X26), a customer number with no digit after BIF DEEDIT (not modelled), a PF10 whose date / credit-score fields came back empty (UNPROT-CUST-DATA MOVEs the symbolic map's LOW-VALUES through a 9(8) REDEFINES: non-digit data in a numeric MOVE, oracle_assumptions.md C11 -- the scenarios give PF10 the screen's fields as shown), and the failure branches after SEND MAP / SEND TEXT / SEND CONTROL / RETURN / LINK / INQUIRE / SET (no fault can be injected on them). Data: customer.txt is cbsa-updcust's (SYNTHETIC).
